title: Socratic phase-2 evidence
description: Evidence produced by the socratic phase-2 agent: a manifest of the synthesized docs (PRD, use-cases, ADRs, arc42). The socratic leg's final tree — the one the combine hook pushes — travels on the engine's `outputs:` transport (issue #68), not in an Actions artifact.

run_id.description: GitHub Actions run id of the phase-2 run — provenance only; the combine hook reads the files from the engine-staged tree, not from an artifact.

files.description: Manifest of synthesized docs (paths relative to the tree root).
